Method of Attack: Impersonates legitimate privnote.com site to steal bitcoins by altering pasted Bitcoin addresses to one controlled by threat actors
Alters Bitcoin address only if paste is accessed from a different IP address than the creator
Adds ads in Google Search to outrank legitimate site
Impacted Systems: Users of privnote.com and privnotes.com websites
Attack Vector: Manipulation of Bitcoin addresses in pasted notes
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin address alteration example: '3J98t1WpEZ73CNmQviecrnyiWrnqRhWNLy' changed to attacker-controlled address with same first four characters
Use of free Let's Encrypt SSL certificate on fake site vs DigiCert on legitimate site
Google Search ads promoting fake site
